Name: Nae's Penguin Pet
Author: nae03
Description:
This mod changes the default cat (or dog) with a cute baby penguin that waddles around your farm aimlessly. (You can change this in the config file.)
It also adds custom penguin sounds.

Do not question how it's physically possible for it to survive in the Stardew Valley climate.

Downloads.Description: Adds a lil penguin baby that replaces the default cat.

Manifest.Name: Penguin Pet
Manifest.Description: Changes the default cat to a baby penguin.
